name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(at_exit, holding_box) does not express “carry the box to the exit.” It only requires carrying the box sometime at or after reaching the exit, and `at_exit` is true only on the episode’s last step, so it cannot ensure the box is carried at the exit. Replace it with the required condition that the box is held when `at_exit` occurs. Keep Existence(at_exit) and Response(box_fell, holding_box).

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require pickup after a fall. It allows holding_box to have happened before box_fell, so the fall can be followed by no pickup. The task requires picking the box up again after each fall; use a rule that requires holding_box after box_fell.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) with Precedence(holding_box, at_exit) requires carrying the box at the exit, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
The box must be in the agent’s hands when it reaches the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again afterward.
